context: After the production fixes land, consolidate the throwaway 47-adapter harness into repository tests. Keep the 47 registration count as an explicit invariant, require zero construct/export/database leaks, and allow only the two known optional ODBC skips with their dependency reason. Use deterministic sentinels and no live PostgreSQL/S3. Sequence after all production fixes so the gate is genuinely red now and the permanent test does not encode a false green baseline. The corrected invariant uses PlatformRegistry.get_available_platforms() and AnonymizationManager, both verified repository APIs.
description: Make the adversarial credential-egress sweep permanent and extend it beyond the existing 47-adapter platform-config/raw-config coverage. The invariant must drive every registered adapter that can be constructed, record optional-dependency skips explicitly, and cover raw_metadata plus normalized metadata blocks, URI query credentials, MCP error scrubbing, and nested tuning companion identifiers through the public/private/database export chokepoints. This is the approved R8 follow-up; it does not introduce SecretStr or the unapproved four-layer proposal. This is the corrected successor of credential-egress-sentinel-invariant-expansion-v1; its stored rung was repaired during adversarial plan review. This successor repoints the corrected prose dependency after adversarial graph review.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not add SecretStr or the unapproved four-layer proposal.
anti_patterns.instead: Keep the scope at deterministic sentinel construction and export chokepoints.
anti_patterns.why: R8 authorizes a permanent invariant test, not a broader architecture change.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not make the sentinel sweep a grep over key names or implementation constants.
anti_patterns.instead: Construct adapters/results and inspect serialized public, private, and database outputs.
anti_patterns.why: The original throwaway sweep found value-materialisation defects that key-list checks missed.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not silently skip adapters because optional dependencies are absent.
anti_patterns.instead: Record the adapter and exact missing dependency, and fail unexpected skips or count drift.
anti_patterns.why: A disappearing adapter would make the invariant vacuous.

preserves.behavior: 47 registered adapter invariant and explicit 45-pass/2-optional-skip accounting where dependencies are unavailable.
Existing focused tests for each individual boundary.
No live cloud service requirement and no credential material in test output.

verifications.command: uv run --all-extras -- python -c 'import json; from benchbox.core.results.platform_options import sanitize_platform_options; from benchbox.mcp.errors import make_execution_error; from benchbox.core.results.anonymization import AnonymizationManager; uri=json.dumps(sanitize_platform_options({"url":"https://example.invalid/x?password=SWEEP_URI_GATE"})); mcp=json.dumps(make_execution_error("dsn=SWEEP_MCP_GATE",exception=Exception("dsn=SWEEP_MCP_GATE"))); tuning=json.dumps(AnonymizationManager().anonymize_tuning_payload({"requested":{"constraints":{"foreign_keys":{"tables":[{"table":"SWEEP_TABLE_GATE","columns":["SWEEP_COLUMN_GATE"]}]}}}})); assert all(x not in uri+mcp+tuning for x in ("SWEEP_URI_GATE","SWEEP_MCP_GATE","SWEEP_TABLE_GATE","SWEEP_COLUMN_GATE"))'
verifications.description: Unfixed-tree gate: the expanded sentinel invariant must report zero leaks across the new metadata, URI, MCP, and tuning cases; current develop fails before production successors land.
verifications.expected: FAIL on unfixed develop: the cross-layer sentinel invariant reports at least one leak; exits 1 before the full production sequence and 0 after the permanent sweep is complete.

verifications.command: uv run --all-extras -- python -c 'from benchbox.core.platform_registry import PlatformRegistry; PlatformRegistry.clear_cache(); assert len(PlatformRegistry.get_available_platforms())==47, len(PlatformRegistry.get_available_platforms())'
verifications.description: Regression guard: the adapter registry remains populated at the reviewed scale before the expanded test is implemented.
verifications.expected: PASS on current develop and after the change: the 47-adapter corpus remains the test universe.
